title: Anything a player might type (foundation §4.2)
description: Every answer or secret word ships with its variants. All lowercase. The file that holds the items carries the pack's `lang` at its top level ($defs/pack, ruling 15): every match function is called with it. The pack test (`checkAnswerPack` in @partybox/game-sdk, ADR-048) normalizes every entry (§4.3), fails on any clash between entries on their compact form (spacing, case, accent and apostrophe variants are automatic, so listing one is a clash), fails when an answer or `accept` does not match its own item as `exact`, and warns under three accepted forms for a common word (aim for six or more where they honestly exist). Code: `answerItemSchema` / `answerPackSchema` mirror this file.

id.description: Stable forever (recaps, flags, overrides key on it).

accept.description: Same answer: plurals, common misspellings, US/UK spellings, abbreviations, true synonyms, brand vs generic. Not spacing, hyphen, case, accent or apostrophe variants, nor number words for digits: the matcher already treats those as the same, and the pack test fails on them.

reject.description: Looks close but is wrong (cat for car, puffin for penguin). Blocks exact and stem matches, and a fuzzy match whenever the input is at least as close to the reject as to the answer (ruling 16).

family.description: Word games only: roots that give the secret away as a clue (sunflower → sun, flower).

lang.description: The content's language: it decides the articles, the number words and the stems.

pack.description: The top level of any content file that holds answer items: a required `lang`, then the game's own shape (a word list, categories, questions) around the items.
